messages:
nina_ops: Heads up 1  Senior Data Scientist candidate (Marco V.) arriving Wed 2026-06-10. Candidate is deaf and requested an in-person ASL interpreter + live captions for all panels. Also asked if Redwood offers dependent-care stipend for daycare on interview day. Need ops to coordinate vendor, room setup, stipend flow, and front-desk note.
olivia_h: Thanks Nina. Confirmed interview window 09:3014:30 PT. Remote panel from 13:0014:30 for east-coast folks. Marco flying in same-day from Seattle.
priya: I can handle dependent-care stipend. What amount are we approving? Also will manage lunch voucher options (vegetarian).
ellie_ops: Reception can reserve Quiet Suite A (private, low-echo) 09:1515:00. Good for interpreters and camera for captions.
recruiter_lee: Candidate uploaded ID and signed NDA via portal. Link: https://portal.redwood.example/upload. Marco also flagged sensitivity re: photos  front desk to avoid posting pictures on arrival.
peopleops_bot: Accessibility request logged. Checklist created: ASL vendor, live captions setup, private room, headphones, power outlets, stipend flow, front-desk note. Reminder: confirm 72h before loop.
sam_p: For live captions, IT can provision Otter.ai live transcript in the room and stream to Zoom. Need AV rig + laptop with HDMI.
priya: Dependent-care stipend approved up to $125 for this candidate (one-time). Expense code: OPS-CARE-2026. Payout via prepaid ACH; recruiter to DM payout details.
nina_ops: Vendor suggestion: ClearVoice Interpreting (local) can book ASL interpreters on short notice. Contact +1-415-555-0200. Estimated rate $65/hr. Can we proceed?
ellie_ops: Reception will coordinate vendor arrival and a discreet greeter. Please provide interpreters name to Reception by 48h prior.
recruiter_lee: I'll confirm Marco's preferred pronouns and interpreter gender preference and DM details to Priya. Also sharing travel ETA once confirmed.
nina_ops: IT note: ensure the room camera faces panelists and capture slides for captions. Also provide a wired ethernet drop and spare charger for candidate medical device.
sam_p: IT will bring an AV laptop preinstalled with Otter.ai, HDMI capture, and external mic. We'll test 30 min before start.
priya: Lunch voucher 1 we will include GF and vegetarian options. I'll send digital code to recruiter by EOD.
peopleops_bot: Calendar invite sent to panelists and candidate (ID: 1954321987-DS-MARCO) with 72h and 30m reminders.
nina_ops: Front desk note: "Candidate requests no photos; greet by name, direct to Quiet Suite A, provide ASL interpreter contact card." Priya please add to Reception instructions.
ellie_ops: Added note to Reception checklist. Will have a sign that says "Reception greeter waiting for Marco V." without any photo.
priya: For dependent-care stipend payout, recruiter please provide recipient name and preferred payment method today so we can execute ACH pre-arrival.
recruiter_lee: DM sent with payout details. Marco prefers ACH.
nina_ops: One more: candidate asked whether interviews will be recorded. Please ensure recordings are off and captions are provided locally only.
sam_p: Confirmed 1 recordings off, local captions via Otter only, no recordings saved. Panelists reminded.
peopleops_bot: Accessibility reminder scheduled: confirm interpreter booking 72h before; test AV 30m before.
priya: All set from benefits side. Will confirm stipend processed and share confirmation to recruiter and candidate.
recruiter_lee: I'll confirm Marco's arrival ETA tomorrow morning and update this thread. Thanks all :heart:
